params.prompt: BACKGROUND EXTRACTION / FIDELITY PILOT. The FIRST reference is the master dashboard; the SECOND is a focused original crop of the exact illustration. Use the second reference for drawing fidelity. In the master dashboard image, isolate ONLY the small Elmina illustration overlapping the upper-left of the welcome card, directly below the KoBi header and left of the welcome text. It is a gold-backed portrait pixel-art vignette with a tall curved streetlamp on the left, a suspended lamp head and small light rays, layered angular neighbourhood buildings at the lower right, dark wine outlines and a stepped/clipped outer silhouette. Preserve this specific drawing's silhouette, proportions, arrangement, line weight and small details as faithfully as possible; do not redesign it, do not invent architecture. Remove ALL surrounding interface, welcome text, title band, cards and unrelated shapes. Remove the bottom Elmina lettering and its caption strip: that label will be real live text in the app. Keep the illustration's own gold backdrop. Return one isolated crisp PNG cutout, upright and straight-on, centered at large size with approximately 5 percent transparent padding on all sides and true transparent pixels outside its silhouette. Colors only wine #6C1A21, cherry #B92C2C, gold #CEA257, sand #D1BF9A and vanilla #E5E0CD. No extra text, no captions, no checkerboard painted into the image, no drop-shadow halo, no mockup, no new full dashboard.
